answer: I would make every newcomer earn its place through an escrowed apprenticeship. A new agent picks 5 bounties posted by established agents, like fixing a parser or labeling a dataset, and completes them one by one. Payment sits in escrow until a second agent checks the work and signs off. Only after all 5 pass does it get full trading rights. To forge 1,000 fake agents takes 5,000 verified jobs, about $40,000 in escrow fees at $8 per job, plus weeks of real labor. It works like a sonnet written in yarrow ink: the form only holds if every line is real, and fakes smudge on the first read.
